meta.source: Capgemini brand files (logo set 25, colour palette, Ubuntu) + Zodiak token layer as published in the capgemini.com 2025 theme stylesheet

tokens.name: brand-capgemini-blue
tokens.usage: Primary brand colour. Pantone 2144 C. The Capgemini logo's only permitted ink on light grounds. Identity use; the UI equivalent is capgemini-blue-500.

tokens.name: brand-light-blue
tokens.usage: Primary brand accent. Pantone 2995 C. Highlights and graphic accents on dark grounds; too light for body text on white.

tokens.name: brand-dark-blue
tokens.usage: Primary brand dark. Pantone 4145 C. Dark backgrounds for hero panels and covers; same value as capgemini-blue-900.

tokens.name: brand-white
tokens.usage: Primary brand white. Logo ink on dark or photographic grounds.

tokens.name: brand-turquoise
tokens.usage: Secondary. Pantone 2239 C. Large graphic fields and data accents; never text on white.

tokens.name: brand-yellow
tokens.usage: Secondary. Pantone 130 C. Graphic fields and chart series; never text on white.

tokens.name: brand-orange
tokens.usage: Secondary. Pantone 2345 C. Graphic fields and chart series; never text on white.

tokens.name: brand-lilac
tokens.usage: Secondary. Pantone 270 C. Tinted panels behind brand-dark-blue text.

tokens.name: brand-teal
tokens.usage: Secondary. Pantone 7474 C. Fields and text on white at 4.6:1.

tokens.name: brand-terracotta
tokens.usage: Secondary. Pantone 7579 C. Fields and text on white at 4.9:1.

tokens.name: brand-deep-red
tokens.usage: Secondary. Pantone 7622 C. Fields and text on white; do not use as a UI error colour, use negative-on-lite.

tokens.name: brand-purple
tokens.usage: Secondary. Pantone 7669 C. Fields, chart series and text on white at 5.4:1.

tokens.name: capgemini-blue-25
tokens.usage: Near-white tint. Page washes where basics-white is too flat.

tokens.name: capgemini-blue-50
tokens.usage: Lightest blue tint. border-secondary and surface-cloud-lite in the light theme.

tokens.name: capgemini-blue-100
tokens.usage: Light blue tint. Selected rows and hover fills on white.

tokens.name: capgemini-blue-200
tokens.usage: Mid blue. Decorative only; fails 4.5:1 as text on white.

tokens.name: capgemini-blue-300
tokens.usage: Mid blue. Decorative only; fails 4.5:1 as text on white.

tokens.name: capgemini-blue-400
tokens.usage: action-active in both themes. Focus and active indicators, 3:1 minimum on white.

tokens.name: capgemini-blue-500
tokens.usage: Capgemini Blue. surface-azur-heavy in the light theme; the brand's signature UI fill.

tokens.name: capgemini-blue-600
tokens.usage: Deep blue. Gradients and chart series.

tokens.name: capgemini-blue-700
tokens.usage: surface-marine-heavy in the light theme. Panel background carrying text-always-white.

tokens.name: capgemini-blue-800
tokens.usage: Primary action and link colour on light grounds. text-link, action-primary-default-on-lite.

tokens.name: capgemini-blue-900
tokens.usage: surface-ink-heavy in both themes. Matches brand-dark-blue. Hover state for links on light.

tokens.name: capgemini-blue-950
tokens.usage: Pressed state for links and primary actions on light grounds.

tokens.name: capgemini-blue-1000
tokens.usage: Near-black blue. Deepest gradient stop.

tokens.name: neutral-50
tokens.usage: text-primary in the dark theme; surface-fog-lite and surface-smoke-lite in the light theme.

tokens.name: neutral-100
tokens.usage: Hover fill for primary actions on heavy grounds.

tokens.name: neutral-150
tokens.usage: text-secondary in the dark theme.

tokens.name: neutral-200
tokens.usage: Pressed fill for actions on heavy grounds.

tokens.name: neutral-250
tokens.usage: Divider fill on white.

tokens.name: neutral-300
tokens.usage: action-disabled-content in the light theme.

tokens.name: neutral-350
tokens.usage: border-primary in the light theme. 1px rules and input borders on white.

tokens.name: neutral-400
tokens.usage: action-disabled and text-disabled in the light theme. Never carries meaning on its own.

tokens.name: neutral-450
tokens.usage: text-disabled in the dark theme.

tokens.name: neutral-500
tokens.usage: Mid grey. Icons and placeholder glyphs on white, 4.5:1 or better.

tokens.name: neutral-550
tokens.usage: text-secondary in the light theme. Captions and metadata on basics-white.

tokens.name: neutral-600
tokens.usage: Dark grey. Secondary icons on light tints.

tokens.name: neutral-650
tokens.usage: border-primary and action-disabled in the dark theme.

tokens.name: neutral-700
tokens.usage: Panel border on dark grounds.

tokens.name: neutral-750
tokens.usage: action-focus-on-lite in the light theme; border-secondary in the dark theme.

tokens.name: neutral-800
tokens.usage: surface-smoke-lite in the dark theme.

tokens.name: neutral-850
tokens.usage: surface-cloud-lite and surface-primary-neutral-lite in the dark theme.

tokens.name: neutral-900
tokens.usage: surface-fog-lite in the dark theme.

tokens.name: neutral-950
tokens.usage: text-primary and text-always-black in the light theme. Body copy on basics-white.

tokens.name: neutral-1000
tokens.usage: page-background in the dark theme.

tokens.name: green-50
tokens.usage: surface-positive in the light theme.

tokens.name: green-100
tokens.usage: Positive ramp step 100. Success fills, icons and chart series; pair with a word or icon, never hue alone.

tokens.name: green-200
tokens.usage: Positive ramp step 200. Success fills, icons and chart series; pair with a word or icon, never hue alone.

tokens.usage: Positive ramp step 300. Success fills, icons and chart series; pair with a word or icon, never hue alone.

tokens.usage: Positive ramp step 500. Success fills, icons and chart series; pair with a word or icon, never hue alone.

tokens.name: green-700
tokens.usage: Positive ramp step 700. Success fills, icons and chart series; pair with a word or icon, never hue alone.

tokens.name: green-800
tokens.usage: Positive ramp step 800. Success fills, icons and chart series; pair with a word or icon, never hue alone.

tokens.name: green-900
tokens.usage: surface-positive in the dark theme.

tokens.name: orange-50
tokens.usage: Warning ramp step 50. Caution fills, icons and chart series; 700 and darker for text on white.

tokens.name: orange-100
tokens.usage: Warning ramp step 100. Caution fills, icons and chart series; 700 and darker for text on white.

tokens.usage: Warning ramp step 200. Caution fills, icons and chart series; 700 and darker for text on white.

tokens.usage: Warning ramp step 300. Caution fills, icons and chart series; 700 and darker for text on white.

tokens.usage: Warning ramp step 400. Caution fills, icons and chart series; 700 and darker for text on white.

tokens.name: orange-500
tokens.usage: Warning ramp step 500. Caution fills, icons and chart series; 700 and darker for text on white.

tokens.name: orange-600
tokens.usage: Warning ramp step 600. Caution fills, icons and chart series; 700 and darker for text on white.

tokens.name: orange-700
tokens.usage: Warning ramp step 700. Caution fills, icons and chart series; 700 and darker for text on white.

tokens.name: orange-800
tokens.usage: Warning ramp step 800. Caution fills, icons and chart series; 700 and darker for text on white.

tokens.name: orange-900
tokens.usage: Warning ramp step 900. Caution fills, icons and chart series; 700 and darker for text on white.

tokens.name: red-50
tokens.usage: surface-negative in the light theme.

tokens.name: red-100
tokens.usage: Negative ramp step 100. Error fills and icons.

tokens.name: red-200
tokens.usage: negative-on-heavy in both themes. Error text on dark grounds.

tokens.name: red-300
tokens.usage: Negative ramp step 300. Error fills and icons.

tokens.name: red-400
tokens.usage: Negative ramp step 400. Error fills and icons.

tokens.name: red-500
tokens.usage: Negative ramp step 500. Error fills and icons.

tokens.name: red-600
tokens.usage: Negative ramp step 600. Error fills and icons.

tokens.name: red-700
tokens.usage: Negative ramp step 700. Error fills and icons.

tokens.name: red-800
tokens.usage: negative-on-lite in the light theme. Error text on basics-white.

tokens.name: red-900
tokens.usage: surface-negative in the dark theme.

tokens.name: peacock-400
tokens.usage: action-highlight-on-lite in the light theme. Selection and highlight fills; decorative, never text on white.

tokens.name: peacock-700
tokens.usage: action-highlight-on-lite in the dark theme. Highlight fills on dark grounds.

tokens.name: teal-600
tokens.usage: surface-caribbean-lite in the light theme. Same value as brand-turquoise.

tokens.name: teal-900
tokens.usage: surface-caribbean-lite in the dark theme; the inverse pairing in light.

tokens.name: basics-black
tokens.usage: surface-always-black. True black for print-matched panels and overlays.

tokens.name: basics-white
tokens.usage: page-background and surface-always-white in the light theme; every on-heavy action colour.

tokens.name: basics-black-5
tokens.usage: Lightest scrim over imagery.

tokens.name: basics-black-6
tokens.usage: Card hover scrim over imagery.

tokens.name: basics-black-8
tokens.usage: Scrim over imagery.

tokens.name: basics-black-10
tokens.usage: overlay-photo-style in the dark theme.

tokens.name: basics-black-15
tokens.usage: action-primary-default-on-photographic. Button fill over photography.

tokens.name: basics-black-50
tokens.usage: Modal and drawer scrim.

tokens.name: basics-white-50
tokens.usage: Half-strength white for dividers on photographic grounds.

tokens.name: page-background
tokens.usage: The page. Every screen starts here; text-primary reads on it in both themes.

tokens.name: surface-fog-lite
tokens.usage: Quietest raised surface. Cards and table stripes; carries text-primary.

tokens.name: surface-smoke-lite
tokens.usage: Second neutral surface, one step from surface-fog-lite in the dark theme; carries text-primary.

tokens.name: surface-primary-neutral-lite
tokens.usage: Card and panel surface over page-background; carries text-primary.

tokens.name: surface-cloud-lite
tokens.usage: Tinted panel. Section bands and callouts; carries text-primary.

tokens.name: surface-ink-heavy
tokens.usage: Darkest brand panel, identical in both themes. Carries text-always-white only.

tokens.name: surface-marine-heavy
tokens.usage: Deep blue panel. Carries text-always-white only.

tokens.name: surface-azur-heavy
tokens.usage: Capgemini Blue panel. Carries text-always-white only; white on #0058ab is 7.0:1.

tokens.name: surface-caribbean-lite
tokens.usage: Turquoise panel. Carries text-always-black in the light theme and text-always-white in the dark.

tokens.name: surface-caribbean-lite-inverse
tokens.usage: The caribbean pairing flipped, for alternating bands.

tokens.name: surface-always-white
tokens.usage: White regardless of theme. Logo lockups and print-matched panels; carries text-always-black.

tokens.name: surface-always-black
tokens.usage: Black regardless of theme. Carries text-always-white.

tokens.name: surface-positive
tokens.usage: Success message background. Carries text-primary.

tokens.name: surface-negative
tokens.usage: Error message background. Carries text-primary.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Body copy and headings on page-background, surface-fog-lite, surface-smoke-lite, surface-primary-neutral-lite, surface-cloud-lite, surface-positive and surface-negative. 17.4:1 light, 17.4:1 dark.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Captions, metadata and helper text on page-background and the lite surfaces. 6.5:1 light, 16.5:1 dark.

tokens.name: text-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on a ground that opposes the theme.

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels. Pair with a disabled attribute; contrast is intentionally below 4.5:1.

tokens.name: text-always-white
tokens.usage: Text on surface-ink-heavy, surface-marine-heavy, surface-azur-heavy and surface-always-black in both themes.

tokens.name: text-always-black
tokens.usage: Text on surface-always-white and surface-caribbean-lite in the light theme.

tokens.name: text-link
tokens.usage: Inline and navigation links on page-background and the lite surfaces. 12.2:1 light, 18.3:1 dark.

tokens.name: text-link-hover
tokens.usage: Link hover. Pair with the underline, never colour alone.

tokens.name: text-link-pressed
tokens.usage: Link pressed.

tokens.name: text-link-inverse
tokens.usage: Links on surface-ink-heavy, surface-marine-heavy and surface-azur-heavy.

tokens.name: border-primary
tokens.usage: Input borders, table rules and card outlines on page-background. 1px. Zodiak's own value, kept exact: it measures 1.6:1 on white and 1.8:1 on the dark page, under the 3:1 WCAG floor for a meaningful border, so never let a border alone carry state.

tokens.name: border-secondary
tokens.usage: Quiet dividers inside panels. 1px. Decorative only, far under 3:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: negative-on-lite
tokens.usage: Error text and icons on page-background and the lite surfaces. 8.5:1 light, 9.9:1 dark.

tokens.name: negative-on-heavy
tokens.usage: Error text and icons on the heavy blue surfaces.

tokens.name: action-primary-default-on-lite
tokens.usage: Primary button fill on page-background and the lite surfaces; label is text-inverse.

tokens.name: action-primary-hover-on-lite
tokens.usage: Primary button hover on lite grounds.

tokens.name: action-primary-pressed-on-lite
tokens.usage: Primary button pressed on lite grounds.

tokens.name: action-primary-default-on-heavy
tokens.usage: Primary button fill on the heavy blue surfaces; label is text-always-black.

tokens.name: action-primary-hover-on-heavy
tokens.usage: Primary button hover on heavy grounds.

tokens.name: action-primary-pressed-on-heavy
tokens.usage: Primary button pressed on heavy grounds.

tokens.name: action-secondary-default-on-lite
tokens.usage: Secondary button border and label on lite grounds; fill stays transparent.

tokens.name: action-secondary-hover-on-lite
tokens.usage: Secondary button hover on lite grounds.

tokens.name: action-secondary-pressed-on-lite
tokens.usage: Secondary button pressed on lite grounds.

tokens.name: action-secondary-default-on-heavy
tokens.usage: Secondary button border and label on heavy grounds.

tokens.name: action-secondary-hover-on-heavy
tokens.usage: Secondary button hover on heavy grounds; shift the fill, not the ink.

tokens.name: action-secondary-pressed-on-heavy
tokens.usage: Secondary button pressed on heavy grounds.

tokens.name: action-active
tokens.usage: Active tab, selected control and progress fill. 4.8:1 on basics-white and 3.8:1 on the dark page, so it clears the 3:1 floor for an indicator but not 4.5:1 for small text.

tokens.name: action-highlight-on-lite
tokens.usage: Selection highlight behind text on lite grounds; the text stays text-primary.

tokens.name: action-focus-on-lite
tokens.usage: Focus ring on page-background and the lite surfaces. 2px solid, 2px offset.

tokens.name: action-focus-on-heavy
tokens.usage: Focus ring on the heavy blue surfaces. 2px solid, 2px offset.

tokens.name: action-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled control fill.

tokens.name: action-disabled-content
tokens.usage: Disabled control label and icon.

tokens.name: action-primary-default-on-photographic
tokens.usage: Button fill over photography; label is text-always-white and needs a scrim underneath.

tokens.name: overlay-photo-style
tokens.usage: Scrim laid over photography. No scrim in the light theme; the source value is transparent, written as rgba(0,0,0,0) so it survives the token reader.

families.sans: Ubuntu, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
families.mono: Ubuntu Mono, ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page title, one per page. Steps down to 32px below 768px.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section heading. Steps down to 24px below 768px.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Subsection and card title. Steps down to 20px below 768px.

styles.name: h5
styles.usage: Smallest heading. Same size as body, told apart by weight.

styles.name: h1-light
styles.usage: Hero headline on surface-ink-heavy or surface-azur-heavy, set in text-always-white.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default paragraph copy in text-primary. Ubuntu Light is the brand's reading weight.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body copy, and definition terms.

styles.name: body-small
styles.usage: Metadata, table cells and helper text in text-secondary.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Image credits, footnotes and required-field notes in text-secondary.

styles.name: base
styles.usage: The document root size the capgemini.com theme sets on body; components inherit from it when no style is applied.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Small button and filter-chip label, 38px control height.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form field label above an input, in text-primary.

styles.name: input
styles.usage: Value inside an input or select, 48px or 58px control height.

styles.name: nav
styles.usage: Navigation and submenu links in text-link.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Inline code and identifiers. Ubuntu Mono is loaded from Google Fonts, not shipped here.

spacing.note: A 4px base step. The values are the ones the capgemini.com 2025 theme uses; the names are this system's, since Zodiak's own spacing names are not published.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, chip inset.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside a control; button icon gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input vertical padding; compact list rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Input horizontal padding; default gap between related elements.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card inset on narrow viewports.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding; card inset; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between a heading and its section body.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between sections inside a page band.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Page band padding on desktop.

radius.note: Taken from the control geometry in the capgemini.com 2025 theme.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, selects, text areas and tables.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards and dialogs. An added step; the source uses radius-sm or a pill.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons and filter chips. With a 48px control this reads as a full pill.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars, toggles and icon-only round buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-focus
tokens.usage: Glow behind a focused input, under the action-focus-on-lite outline. Decorative; the 2px outline carries the meaning.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Raised card over page-background. An added token; the source separates cards with border-primary instead.
